purpose: Collects a single line of free-form text from the user. Used in forms for names, emails, passwords, search queries and other short text values.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label text associated with the input

props.name: type
props.description: HTML input type. Defaults to text

props.name: name
props.description: HTML name attribute for form submission

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error message shown below the input

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text shown below the input

props.name: variant
props.description: Validation style. Defaults to error when errorMessage is set, otherwise default

whenToUse: For single-line free-form text entry such as name, email, or search
When the user needs to enter a value that cannot be predicted in advance
Inside a form to collect structured user input
whenNotToUse: For multi-line text — use a textarea instead
For choosing from a known set of options — use Select or a radio group
For yes/no or on/off choices — use Checkbox or Toggle
antiPatterns: Omitting a visible label — always provide a label element, not just a placeholder
Using placeholder text as the only label
Nesting an Input inside another Input

anatomy: Label above, 40px field, helper or error text below; error text leads with a square error icon
states: focus: 2px `color-interactive-focus-ring` ring with a gap and a `color-border-interactive` border, no tint
error: `color-border-danger` border and `color-text-danger` message only, no tinted fill
motion: Border colour over `motion-duration-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: Every input must have an associated label element via htmlFor/id pair
Error messages must be linked via aria-describedby
Disabled inputs must set aria-disabled='true' and retain focus visibility
Password inputs must offer a show/hide toggle for WCAG 1.3.5
